notes: typing is static — Java is statically typed by default, unlike the other profiles in this department. learning_curve is high because it's evaluated against a JS-only baseline — a developer must learn Java, JVM build tooling (Maven/Gradle), and Spring's annotation-driven dependency injection in addition to Boot itself. operational_complexity and horizontal_scaling assume standard managed JVM hosting (e.g. AWS Elastic Beanstalk) — both shift lower on a serverless JVM runtime and higher for manually managed on-prem clusters.
